Crash · Lithuania

Šiulgiai: border guards recover cross-border cigarette drone

10 October 2026 – 11 October 2026 · Šiulgiai · cross-border cigarette drone

VSAT-confirmed smuggling drone intercepted and recovered

Saturday night, 10–11 October 2026: Control taken over; drone fell in woodland and was recovered about 500 m from border.

250 NZ Gold cigarette packs were recovered. VSAT describes criminal transport from Belarus; operator nationality and state sponsorship remain unestablished.
